question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 2.
solution:
The correct answer is **"wants".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• "*Each person (2) ______ to fulfil his desires and dreams without (3)" *in this sentence we need to fill the blank as per **correct grammatical rule.**
 
• In this at the beginning,we are having** 'each'** which is always used with a singular countable noun.
 
• Verbs with** 'each' **is always conjugated in the **singular **form.
 
• When **'each'** is part of the subject of the sentence ,it is used with a **singular verb**,except when it follows a plural subject.
 
• From the given options,only the verb** 'wants' i**s in the singular form.
 
• Hence,the **option 2 **is the correct answer.
 
• **Correct paragraph** :*There is so much **uncertainty a**nd confusion in life today because the goal of human beings is not clear. Each person **wants t**o fulfil his desires and dreams without (3) ______ the interest of the other. When we have a (4) ______ motive, we lose the sense of the higher objective of attaining happiness. Therefore, there is lot of (5) ______ in our life.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **'Each' **is used for referring to all the people or things in a group,especially when considering every one separately.

 
 
• *Example: **Each **man strives alone.*
